bullets: The Quran guides the God-conscious who believe in the unseen
Establishing prayer and giving from provision mark the believers
Certainty in the Hereafter completes the description of the successful
coreArgument: The opening defines the Quran as guidance for those with taqwa and lists their core traits.
flowConnection: Leads into the contrasting portraits of disbelievers and hypocrites that follow.

bullets: Adam is appointed khalifah on earth before his creation
The angels question and then witness Adam's taught knowledge
Prostration is commanded; Iblis refuses out of pride
coreArgument: Human vicegerency is established through divinely taught knowledge, and arrogance is the first sin.
flowConnection: Sets up the fall, repentance, and the covenant narrative that follows.

bullets: Oaths by the scattering winds and rain-bearing clouds
Judgment Day is presented as inevitable and certain
The righteous are promised gardens while deniers are warned
coreArgument: Cosmic oaths prove the certainty of resurrection and recompense.
flowConnection: Transitions into the stories of past nations who denied the messengers.

bullets: An oath by the star affirms the Prophet's truthfulness
The revelation comes from the Almighty, not from error or desire
The vision at the Lote Tree confirms the heavenly origin
coreArgument: The Prophet's experience is defended as authentic revelation witnessed at the highest horizon.
flowConnection: Flows into the critique of idol worship that corrupted pure monotheism.

bullets: The chapter opens with the Most Merciful teaching the Quran
Sun, moon, stars, trees and balance display divine order
The refrain asks which favors of the Lord can be denied
coreArgument: Gratitude is demanded through a catalogue of cosmic and earthly blessings.
flowConnection: Continues cataloguing blessings over jinn and humankind alike.

bullets: All in heavens and earth glorify Allah, the Mighty and Wise
Dominion, life, death and full knowledge belong to Him
He is with you wherever you are and sees all deeds
coreArgument: Absolute divine sovereignty and nearness ground the call to faith and charity.
flowConnection: Leads into the summons to spend and believe before hardship arrives.
themeTitle: Dominion of the Heavens and Earth

bullets: Allah hears the pleading woman disputing about her husband
Zihar is abolished as a false, unjust utterance
Expiation is prescribed before resuming marital relations
coreArgument: Divine hearing protects the vulnerable and reforms unjust pre-Islamic customs.
flowConnection: Opens the longer legislation on private counsel and assembly conduct.

bullets: Believers are urged to practice what they preach
Ahmad is announced as a messenger after Jesus
Striving with wealth and selves is the profitable trade
coreArgument: Sincerity and sacrifice in Allah's cause define the true ranks of believers.
flowConnection: Closes with the call to support Allah's religion as the disciples did.

bullets: Allah sends the unlettered Messenger to purify and teach
The Book and wisdom lift people out of manifest error
Knowledge carried without practice is like a burdened donkey
coreArgument: Revelation dignifies its bearers only when learned, lived and taught.
flowConnection: Moves to Friday worship as the weekly anchor of remembrance.

bullets: Blessed is He in whose hand is all dominion
Life and death test who is best in deeds
Seven heavens in harmony show no flaw in creation
coreArgument: Sovereignty, testing and flawless creation prove Allah alone deserves worship.
flowConnection: Warns of the blazing punishment awaiting persistent deniers.
themeTitle: Dominion and the Test of Deeds

bullets: The Pen witnesses that the Prophet is not mad
His character is exalted above every insult
The deniers wish for compromise but truth does not bend
coreArgument: The Prophet's character and revelation are vindicated against mockery.
flowConnection: Continues with the parable of the garden owners who withheld charity.

bullets: A company of jinn hears the wondrous Quran and believes
They affirm Allah has no consort and no offspring
Seeking refuge in jinn increased only burden and error
coreArgument: The Quran's recitation converts even unseen hearers and corrects superstition.
flowConnection: The jinn testimony continues against fortune-tellers and false refuges.

bullets: Disputers question the Great News of resurrection
The earth, mountains, sleep and night show measured design
A mighty reward awaits the God-conscious in gardens
coreArgument: Everyday creation signs make the coming Day of Sorting undeniable.
flowConnection: Proceeds to the Day the Trumpet is blown and deeds are exposed.

bullets: Glorify the name of the Most High Creator
He decrees, guides, brings forth pasture and sustains
Ease is granted for the Reminder that benefits
coreArgument: Creation, decree and guidance all flow from the Most High worth glorifying.
flowConnection: The Reminder benefits believers and warns against the great Fire.
